related_separate_overlay_research.finding: Two distinct file_12 overlay callback candidates match 20/20 and 36/36 isolated instruction bytes. They remain unpromoted pending an overlay unit/relocation adapter and full-ROM/inventory proof; they are not members of the 13-function main-segment list.

reusable_abi_lessons: The VM program cursor at 0x80077858 is distinct from the signed-halfword text cursor in 0x801C77E8.
Callbacks can mutate the globals being traversed; match original reload points instead of caching values across calls.
Branch-likely delay slots, register allocation, and original spill/frame layout are observable; equal size or host semantics is not exactness.
Resource ID, loaded resource base, relocation delta, and relocated program address are distinct values.
A complete 10,112-byte translation-unit comparison is necessary because a target change can move siblings and forward-call relocations.
Overlay VMAs require file/section mapping separate from the main-segment VMA-to-ROM formula.
